svg.title: How an audit runs
svg.desc: Flow chart with 7 steps and 7 connections. Main path: CLI → Browser manager → Chrome via CDP → Accessibility tree → WCAG engine → Report. Most connected: Accessibility tree (3 connections). Bottlenecks: Chrome via CDP and Accessibility tree; without either the diagram falls apart. CLI (start): leads to Browser manager. Browser manager: leads to Chrome via CDP. Chrome via CDP (external): leads to Accessibility tree. Accessibility tree: leads to WCAG engine and Analysis modules. WCAG engine: leads to Report. Analysis modules: leads to Report. Report (end): no further step.
